newer_changes_search: Web search for post-commencement changes: the Ministry of Rural Development notified state-wise wage rates under Section 10 of the VB-G RAM G Act on 30 June 2026, effective 1 July 2026 (reported by SCC Online 6 Jul 2026, Outlook, Upstox, Vikaspedia; the notification supersedes the 26 Feb 2013 notification; lowest rate Rs 300/day, national average about Rs 327/day vs Rs 298.8 under MGNREGA). I did not find the PIB release text itself. The PIB FAQ used as source is dated 11 May 2026, before that notification. Act in force from 1 July 2026 as stated.

findings.note: 'Until new wage rates are notified, the old MGNREGA wage rates apply.' (and the same sentence in hi, plus the fact quoting it) is outdated: new state-wise wage rates under the Act were notified on 30 June 2026 and apply from 1 July 2026. Users would be told the old MGNREGA rates still apply.
findings.suggestion: Replace the sentence in en and hi with: 'Each state has its own daily wage rate, notified under the Act from 1 July 2026; ask your gram panchayat for your state's rate.' / 'हर राज्य की अपनी दैनिक मज़दूरी दर है, जो 1 जुलाई 2026 से अधिनियम के तहत अधिसूचित है; अपने राज्य की दर ग्राम पंचायत से पूछें।' Add a source for the 30-6-2026 MoRD wage-rate notification (egazette.gov.in or a PIB/nrega.dord.gov.in page) with a quote, and drop the fact 'Until new Wage Rates are notified ... shall continue to apply'. Optionally state the Rs 300 minimum only if the official notification says so.

findings.note: rural (area == rural) and age_min (>= 18) match 'Every rural household whose adult members volunteer ...' and 'Adult members of rural areas may demand employment'. guidance fits a PIB FAQ. Fixtures cover 17/18, urban and missing fields.
findings.suggestion: Optional: cite the Act (Gazette) for 'confirmed' confidence.

findings.note: aadhaar cites the commencement release, which only mentions 'e-KYC verified job cards'. Loose support.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as optional; better cite a source that names Aadhaar-based e-KYC.

findings.note: Other statements (125 days, 15 days or unemployment allowance, weekly / fortnight wages via DBT, 5 km / 10% extra, peak-season pause) all match quoted FAQ text.
